column3: “Havvoth-jair” transliterates “villages of Jair”; NASB moves “in the land of Gilead” forward.
“afflicted and crushed” renders “shattered and crushed”; NASB supplies “for … they afflicted.”
NASB supplies “Did I not deliver you”; the Hebrew sentence is incomplete.
“the Amalekites and the Maonites” renders “Amalek and Maon”; “hands” renders the Hebrew singular “hand.”
“whatever seems good to You” renders “according to all that is good in your eyes.”
“put away” renders “removed”; “He could bear the misery of Israel no longer” renders “His soul was short with the trouble of Israel.”
